title: add: prompt-set regression gating + CI eval hook
author: Marcus Boyd
description: Adds a prompt-set regression gating step to the eval-harness and wires an eval-centric CI job that runs on PRs. Motivation: prevent silent regressions in prompt-based quality during model rollouts and infra changes by running a lightweight eval set and failing the PR if configured metrics degrade beyond thresholds. This change includes: a new regression gate implementation (configurable via eval config), a CI workflow (.github/workflows/eval-regressions.yml) that runs the gate on PRs and posts artifacts, an S3/CB artifact uploader for detailed diffs, unit tests for the gate, and docs for how to configure thresholds and exemptions. The description below documents the commits, changed files, review conversation, CI checks, and merge details.

review_comments: Priya Nair: Nice work. Two requests: (1) make thresholds configurable per-metric with fallbacks, (2) please ensure eval job runtime is bounded by default (30s).
Marcus Boyd: Addressed both — added per-metric threshold map and a runtime timeout flag in the workflow. PTAL.
Diego Alvarez: Can we avoid failing on flaky metrics? Suggest adding a rolling-window or require N runs before hard-failing.
Marcus Boyd: Added a soft-fail mode and an opt-in rolling-window config; CI defaults to hard-fail for now but infra teams can flip via repo settings. Added tests for soft-fail path.
Eleanor Chen: minor nit on logging format; prefer structured JSON lines for downstream parsers. Also confirm artifact retention TTL.
Marcus Boyd: Switched to JSONL output and added artifact TTL config (30d) to upload script.
merge_summary: Merged by Priya Nair via squash-merge after approvals. Squashed 4 commits into one. Merge resolved CI flakiness by pinning the eval runner timeout and adding a retry for transient fetch errors.
release_notes: Add eval-harness prompt-set regression gating and CI hook: new RegressionGate to run lightweight prompt-set checks on PRs; new eval-regressions workflow that fails PRs when configured metrics regress beyond thresholds; artifact upload for diffs and JSONL output for downstream tooling.
notes_for_ops: CI job runs a small sample eval (default 50 prompts). If you see repeated failures on CI, check metric thresholds in .github/eval-gating-config.yml and consider adding repository exemptions for experimental model branches.
testing_and_validation: Added unit tests for thresholding and soft-fail behavior. Manual validation: ran workflow on staging repo with A/B model pairs, confirmed CI posts artifact URL and PR status. Load impact: workflow uses small sample and runs in parallel to other CI jobs; no measurable increase in CI queue time in our tests.
